ValidationRule.description: Check required fields to add product
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', Opportunity.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Education', Opportunity.Probability >= 0.90, CONTAINS('Cross Border',PricebookEntry.Product2.Name), Opportunity.No_International_Payers_At_Opportunity__c > 0 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The field 'No. International Payers At Opportunity' must be filled in to calculate Cross Border ARR
